newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Straits sets US$40 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Straits sets US$40 mln facility.

text.p: Copper producer Straits Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it has entered into a US$40 million five year syndicated revolving multi-currency facility agreement.
Straits chief executive Brian Rear said in a statement the facility provided Straits with access to competitively priced funding on flexible terms.
"With this facility and the continuing strong cashflow from the Girilambone Copper Mine, the company will not need to raise equity capital in the near term," he said.
The facilty would be available for general corporate purposes, including funding the group's share of development costs of the Sebuku coal project in Indonesia.
